module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Slippage Tolerance Violation on Child Orders
precondition: Master sets max slippage tolerance = 2.0 pips; market slips 3.5 pips.
expected: Child order rejected or executed with price improvement; investor protected from off-market fills.
coverage_note: Requires LP partial-fill, depth, rejection, or routing fault injection; these dedicated accounts are B-book and no LP simulator was supplied.
